desc.Rth6JH3HSY4: Thank God for Bringing You Through Today | Evening Prayer Before You Sleep Before you go to sleep tonight, take a few moments to thank God for bringing you through another day. This powerful Prayer to Thank God Before Bed is an opportunity to slow down, reflect on God's goodness, and appreciate the blessings we sometimes take for granted. Whether you had a wonderful day or faced unexpected challenges, this evening prayer will help you develop a grateful heart, find peace in God's presence, and remember that His love never leaves you. As you pray, you will thank the Lord for the gift of life, your family, daily provision, protection, answered prayers, and even the difficult moments that have helped you grow in faith. You will also ask God for forgiveness, place tomorrow in His hands, and surrender the worries that may be keeping your heart from resting peacefully. Through the promises of 1 Thessalonians 5:18 and Psalm 4:8, this night prayer reminds us that gratitude is not about having a perfect life but about recognizing God's goodness in every season. Pray along with us tonight, reflect on the blessings in your life, and allow God's peace to fill your heart and home before you close your eyes. May you sleep with a thankful heart and wake up tomorrow with renewed faith and strength. Amen. desc.pRe_5qh0sPE: Good morning, Heavenly Father 🙏 Begin today with this powerful morning prayer — a full prayer of gratitude, surrender and trust in God's plan for your day. If you woke up carrying worry, decisions you don't know how to make, or a heart that feels heavy — this morning prayer is for you. Pray it slowly and let God's Word settle your heart before the day begins. In this morning prayer we thank God for a new day, ask Him for guidance and peace, pray for family and friends, ask for strength in our work, and surrender our plans, dreams and fears into His hands. Every part is rooted in Scripture: • Proverbs 3:5–6 — Trust in the Lord with all your heart • Isaiah 26:3 — Perfect peace for a mind stayed on Him • Colossians 3:23 — Work as unto the Lord • Proverbs 15:1 — A gentle answer turns away wrath • Philippians 4:8 — Think on what is true and good • Psalm 37:5 — Commit your way to the Lord • Matthew 6:31–33 — Seek first the kingdom of God • Isaiah 40:31 — Renewed strength for those who wait • Lamentations 3:22–23 — New mercies every morning Pray this daily morning prayer first thing, and come back each day for a new prayer, verse and word of encouragement. God's mercies are new every morning — and He is not done writing your story. 🙏 Write "Amen" in the comments if you are trusting God with today. 🔔 Subscribe for new daily prayers, Bible verses and morning devotionals. 💬 Leave a prayer request below — we pray over them.

desc.NX9EDmjLRx4: God’s presence is the only source of true satisfaction! Wealth or poverty, sickness or healing, our circumstances are always changing, but God never does. In this Better Together conversation, join Laurie Crouch, Kalley Heiligenthal, Chrystal Evans Hurst, Sheila Walsh, and Blynda Lane as we talk about finding deep fulfillment and wholeness in our Almighty God. Let’s explore what it means to live an abundant life rooted in who God is! “With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.” – Psalm 91:16 (NIV) This video was brought to you by TBN Networks®.
